document.abstract: The road to the future of cinema is paved with a wealth of innovations that define the experience of what's to come. The 2015 NAB Show's Technology Summit on Cinema (TSC), produced in partnership with SMPTE, took participants on a journey of discovery focusing on the next-generation of technology. From 11–12 April, the two-day summit, titled Building the Future of Storytelling, looked ahead to the future, examining the impact that both art and science have on content and that will ultimately shape the future of cinema.
